instructions: Choose one ordinary keyboard input to hold for one second. Each option specifies the key or keys held together.

controls.instructions: W is throttle, S is brake/reverse, A and D steer, Space is the handbrake, and Enter confirms a displayed menu or result selection.

throttle_left.description: Hold W and A: throttle and left steering.

throttle_right.description: Hold W and D: throttle and right steering.

brake_reverse_left.description: Hold S and A: brake or reverse with left steering.

brake_reverse_right.description: Hold S and D: brake or reverse with right steering.

steer_left.description: Hold A: left steering without throttle or brake.

steer_right.description: Hold D: right steering without throttle or brake.

handbrake_left.description: Hold Space and A: handbrake and left steering.

handbrake_right.description: Hold Space and D: handbrake and right steering.

throttle_handbrake.description: Hold W and Space: throttle and handbrake.

throttle_handbrake_left.description: Hold W, Space and A: throttle, handbrake and left steering.

throttle_handbrake_right.description: Hold W, Space and D: throttle, handbrake and right steering.

confirm.description: Hold Enter: confirm the displayed menu or result selection.
